stories.headline: An Inventor of Apple’s FaceID Wants to Analyze Your Brain’s Health With AI
stories.dek: Gidi Littwin’s new AI startup, Hemispheric, makes diagnostic brain scans for conditions like depression, PTSD, and Parkinson’s. He wants the technology to be as cheap and easy as for a blood test.

stories.headline: Whatnot acquires Shaped to power real-time live shopping recommendations
stories.dek: Livestream shopping platform Whatnot has acquired AI startup Shaped, a machine learning company focused on real-time recommendations and search. The deal will bolster Whatnot’s personalization and discovery features as it expands into new product categories.
